description: Project scaffolding: add all dependencies to pubspec.yaml, update AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist, and create all model and service layer files (lib/models/, lib/services/). This feature has no dependency on FEAT-002.
steps: Step 1 — pubspec.yaml: Replace the dependencies block with the full list specified in plan.md item 1. Add 'timezone: ^0.9.0' explicitly (required by flutter_local_notifications zonedSchedule). Run 'flutter pub get' to resolve.

Step 2 — AndroidManifest.xml: Add the six <uses-permission> entries and the two flutter_local_notifications <receiver> entries inside <application> as specified in plan.md item 2. Add the SET_ALARM intent to the <queries> block.
Step 3 — Info.plist: Add NSUserNotificationUsageDescription and UIBackgroundModes keys as specified in plan.md item 3.

Step 4 — lib/models/shift.dart: Create the ShiftType enum with fromString factory (case-insensitive, WFH checked before plain early shift) and Shift class with fromCsvRow factory, toJson/fromJson, and isPast getter. Use intl DateFormat('dd-MMM-yy') to parse dates. Import: package:intl/intl.dart.

Step 5 — lib/models/shift_rule.dart: Create ShiftRule with alarmTime (TimeOfDay), shiftStart (TimeOfDay), type (ShiftType), displayName (String getter). Add static defaults list with all five shift types. Add nightBeforeDefault constant = TimeOfDay(hour:20,minute:0). Add toJson/fromJson.

Step 6 — lib/services/storage_service.dart: Create StorageService with saveShifts, loadShifts, saveRules, loadRules, loadNightBefore, isFirstLaunch, setOnboarded methods all using shared_preferences. Keys: 'shifts', 'rules', 'nightBefore', 'onboarded'.

Step 7 — lib/services/csv_parser.dart: Create CsvParser with static parseCsv(String) method using CsvToListConverter from the csv package. Wrap each row in try/catch to skip header and malformed rows.

Step 8 — lib/services/alarm_service.dart: Create AlarmService with init(), scheduleAll(), and countScheduled() methods. init() sets up FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin. scheduleAll() cancels existing notifications then iterates shifts: for Android wake alarms use AndroidIntent with android.intent.action.SET_ALARM and SKIP_UI=true; for iOS and night-before on both platforms use plugin.zonedSchedule() with tz.TZDateTime. Use deterministic notification IDs: base = shift.date.millisecondsSinceEpoch ~/ 60000, nightBeforeId = base * 2, wakeId = base * 2 + 1. Import dart:io for Platform.isAndroid check.
